answer: Give every identity a garden to tend: for 3 epochs it may move at most 40 units per transaction and 200 per day, each transfer tied to one jade seal that cannot be copied. A thread-thin clone is harmless, but 200 fakes together still cap at 40,000 units a day, while a clean epoch doubles the limits. Any violation resets the identity to probation and burns 25% of its stake, so a farm must fund 200 stakes that sit frozen.
